releaseFallback.sharingOn: Your choice is shared with MovieVault so others scanning this disc find it. Only the release details travel - never anything about you or your collection.
preferences.cardSharingHelp: Help the shared catalogue by contributing the releases you identify.
preferences.shareReleaseSelectionsHelp: When a barcode is not recognised and you pick the pressing you are holding, send those release details to MovieVault for review. Only public disc information is sent - never your collection, viewing history or anything identifying you.
contribute.title: Send corrections to MovieVault
contribute.introLead: Corrections you send are reviewed by a MovieVault moderator before anything changes for anyone else.
contribute.introSends: Only the fields listed below travel, together with the value MovieVault currently holds so the moderator can compare them.
contribute.introNever: Your collection, viewing history, notes, location, purchase details and artwork are never sent.
contribute.queued: Sent for moderation. A moderator decides whether it is applied.
contribute.notInCatalogue: This film is not in this server's copy of the MovieVault catalogue, so there is nothing to compare against yet.
contribute.notInCatalogueCopy: This film is not in this server's copy of the MovieVault catalogue, which was last updated {when}. A release added or approved after that becomes correctable once the catalogue syncs again.
contribute.proposeLead: MovieVault has no release for this film yet. What you have recorded can be offered as a new one, and a moderator reviews it before it exists for anyone else.
contribute.nothingSendableTitle: Nothing can be sent from this release right now.
contribute.withheld.oneBarcode: MovieVault keeps a list of barcodes and DiscVault keeps one, so sending it would delete the others.
contribute.withheld.differentField: The upstream field is not the same field, so sending it would invent data.
contribute.withheld.list: DiscVault keeps a list here and MovieVault keeps one value, so joining them would lose detail.
contribute.withheld.notStored: DiscVault does not store this field.
contribute.withheld.countryCode: MovieVault needs a two-letter country code. Change this field to a code such as NL to contribute it.
contribute.withheld.languageCode: MovieVault needs a language code. Change this field to a code such as nl to contribute it.
contribute.field.title: Title
preferences.shareFieldCorrectionsHelp: Adds a Contribute button next to your edits. Nothing is sent until you confirm each field, and a moderator reviews it before the shared catalogue changes.
preferences.confirmEveryUpload: Explain what is shared every time
preferences.confirmEveryUploadHelp: Repeats the explanation of what does and does not travel every time you contribute, instead of only the first time.
contribute.disabledLead: This DiscVault does not send anything to MovieVault. That is an owner setting, not a personal one, so agreeing to share here would change nothing.
contribute.disabledWhere: An owner can turn it on under Admin, Security, with Toggle Release Contribution. The same switch covers releases and field corrections.
preferences.cardMovieVaultContributionHe: Whether this DiscVault may send anything to the shared catalogue at all. Each user still decides for themselves, and nothing is sent without confirming it field by field.
preferences.movieVaultContributionHelp: Covers both the releases people identify and the field corrections they send. Off means nothing leaves this instance, whatever a user has agreed to.
preferences.movieVaultNotRegistered: Not registered yet. The first contribution registers this instance.
contribute.comparedAgainstMirror: Compared against this DiscVault's copy of the catalogue, which may be behind. A value that has moved since is refused at review rather than applied.
contribute.historyHelp: What you proposed to MovieVault and what a moderator decided. A correction can take days to be reviewed.
contribute.historyEmpty: You have not contributed anything yet.
notifications.prefContributionsHelp: Tell me when a MovieVault moderator decides on a correction I sent.
